name: A non-2xx HTTP response is a result, not a transport error
description: POST /deny on the demo server returns 403 with a JSON error body. A completed HTTP exchange -- including 3xx/4xx/5xx -- is normalized and handed to assertions like any other response, so a scenario may legitimately assert status_equals: 403 and PASS. Requires examples/http/demo_server.py running on 127.0.0.1:8080.
